description: Source code for parsing and representing Linux kernel /proc/crypto information within the Prometheus procfs package.

classes.name: Crypto
classes.description: Struct representing cryptographic algorithm information parsed from /proc/crypto.

methods.name: FS.Crypto
methods.description: Reads and parses /proc/crypto to return a slice of Crypto structs.

methods.name: Crypto.parseKV
methods.description: Parses a key-value pair into the Crypto struct fields.
